title: B-roll index
description: Catalog of stills and clips that can cover a spoken line. Built by broll-index.py. descriptions and rejects are written back by broll-search.py --confirm / --reject and must survive --update. Schema 1.3 adds sampled video frames, color_hint, and the sampling settings used for this build.

schema.description: Writers emit broll-index/1.3. Readers accept 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3.

built.description: UTC ISO timestamp of this build or update.

clip_model.description: open_clip architecture/weights used for entry.clip, e.g. ViT-B-32/laion2b_s34b_b79k. null when no embeddings were stored.

thumbs_dir.description: Directory of <=400px JPEG thumbs. Set when --thumbs is given, or when --thumbs is omitted and --clip defaults to ~/.cache/reel-factory/thumbs/<index basename>/. null when no thumbs were written. Search can find thumbs here.

video_step_s.description: Seconds between sampled video frames (--video-step, default 3.0). Clips longer than step times max-frames spread frames evenly. null on indexes written before 1.3.

video_max_frames.description: Max frames sampled per clip (--video-max-frames, default 8). Clips under 1.0 s get one frame. null on indexes written before 1.3.

rel.description: Path relative to its root, posix separators.

root.description: Absolute root this file was found under.

project.description: Default: first path component under the root, or prefix:auto when every root is flat (more than 50 files, no subfolders). Overridden by --project-from parent|grandparent|prefix:N|prefix:auto|regex:PATTERN. prefix:N takes the first N hyphen tokens of the basename after stripping a trailing responsive size token (320, 640, 1024, 1600, 2048) and then a 1-3 digit image number. prefix:auto keeps every remaining token after that strip. A leading 4-digit year counts as a token. regex:PATTERN is tried against the basename first, then the relative path; the first capture group wins.

name_tokens.description: Filename stem split on -, _, ., spaces, camelCase. Digit runs kept as tokens. Lowercased.

mtime.description: Unix mtime (float). Combined with size for --update change detection.

taken.description: EXIF DateTimeOriginal for images (when Pillow can read it); ffprobe creation_time for videos; else null.

duration_s.description: Video duration in seconds. null for images.

fps.description: Video frame rate from r_frame_rate or avg_frame_rate. null for images or when unreadable.

color_hint.description: From signalstats YMIN on the middle frame of a video. YMIN >= 20 is log, else rec709. null for images or when unreadable.

caption.description: From --captions (basename, case-insensitive) or --captions-from-alt (img/markdown/frontmatter alt, else page title). An explicit --captions file wins when both sources caption the same file.

page_title.description: Title of a page that referenced this image, from --captions-from-alt (frontmatter title: or first # heading).

variant_of.description: Basename of the unsuffixed image when this file is a responsive size variant kept with --keep-variants. Omitted or null otherwise.

descriptions.description: Verified subjects. Appended by broll-search.py --confirm. Preserved across --update.

rejects.description: Subjects this file was judged not to show. Appended by broll-search.py --reject. Preserved across --update. A matching query drops the candidate.

sha1_16.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA-1 of the first 1 MB. Change detection helper.

thumb.description: Absolute path to a <=400px JPEG thumbnail. For videos this is the most representative sampled frame (closest to the mean embedding when --clip, else the middle frame). Images are a 400px JPEG of the still.

frames.description: Sampled frames for a video entry. Empty or omitted for images and for videos indexed without a thumbs dir. --update keeps this array when size+mtime are unchanged.

clip_dtype.description: How entry.clip is stored. f16 = base64 little-endian float16. list = JSON array of floats. Omitted on indexes written before 1.2; readers treat a numeric array as list.

clip_dim.description: Length of the CLIP vector. 512 for ViT-B-32. Omitted when clip is omitted.

clip.description: open_clip image embedding. For videos with --clip this is the L2-normalized mean of the sampled frame embeddings. Writers default to a base64 string of little-endian float16 (clip_dtype f16). Readers also accept the legacy JSON array of 512 floats. Omitted when embeddings were skipped.

oneOf.description: Legacy float list (clip_dtype list or a 1.0/1.1 index).

t.description: Seconds from the start of the clip for this sampled frame.

thumb.description: Absolute path to the JPEG for this frame.

clip.description: Embedding of this frame, same encoding as entry.clip. null when --clip was off or the embed failed.
